summary: The root هوي (hwy) primarily signifies falling or descending, often implying a downward motion or a plunge.

provenance.lane: Edward William Lane, An Arabic-English Lexicon (1863-93), public domain. Digital text via Perseus, Tufts University, CC BY-SA 3.0 US.
provenance.summary: Editorial summary derived from the Lane entry. NOT Lane's own wording. Shown as a gloss only; the Lane text below is the source.

headwords.gloss: He made it to fall down; His ears heard a confused; humming

parts.t: He made it to fall down:
see an ex. in a verse of Ru-beh, cited voce
is used to express wonder; like as when one says,

headwords.def: هَوَى بِهِ He made it to fall down: see an ex. in a verse of Ru-beh, cited voce رِياَغٌ , in art. ريغ . See 4. هَوَتْ أُذُنُهُ His ears heard a confused, or humming, or singing, sound. (K.) هَوَتْ أُمُّهُ is used to express wonder; like as when one says, قَاتَلَهُ ٱللّٰهُ مَا أَسْمَعَهُ . (IB, in TA, art. ام .)

headwords.gloss: He extended; stretched forth, his arm; hand, to the thing to take it

parts.t: hand, to the thing to take it;
it being near: if it be distant, you say,
He reached his sword; took it with his hand,
[in my copy of the Msb, erroneously,
I made a sign with the thing.

headwords.def: أَهْوَى إِلَى الشَّىْءِ بِيَدِهِ He extended, or stretched forth, his arm, or hand, to the thing to take it; it being near: if it be distant, you say, إِلَيْهِ , without ا . (Msb.) And أَهْوَى إِلى سَيْفِهِ He reached his sword; took it with his hand, or with his extended hand; or took hold of it. (Msb.) And أَهْوَيْتُ بِالشَّىْءِ [in my copy of the Msb, erroneously, إِلَى الشَّىْءِ ] I made a sign with the thing. (As, S.)
تَهَوَّهَ : see آهَةٌ , in art. اوه .
اِنْهَوَى : see اِنْغَوَى , in art. غو .
هَاهْ and هَاهُ : see آهِ , in art. اوه .

headwords.gloss: Love; attachment; inclination of the soul

parts.t: ]. (K, Ham, p. 546.) [Being originally an inf. n., it may be used alike as sing. and pl. See an ex. in a verse cited in the first paragraph of art.
The inclination of the soul to that in which the animal appetites take delight, without any lawful invitation thereto;

headwords.def: الهَوَى Love, and attachment: then, inclination of the soul, or mind, to a thing: then, blameable inclination; as when one says, اِتَّبَعَ هَوَاهُ [ He followed his evil inclination ]; and هُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الأَهْوَآءِ [see below]. (Msb.) See also حُبٌّ . هَوًى Also signifies Beloved [or an object of love ]. (K, Ham, p. 546.) [Being originally an inf. n., it may be used alike as sing. and pl. See an ex. in a verse cited in the first paragraph of art. زين : and see an ex. voce شَكْلٌ . الهَوَى The inclination of the soul to that in which the animal appetites take delight, without any lawful invitation thereto; (KT;) [ natural desire: ] love, and desire; generally, such as is not praiseworthy: (Mgh:) I render it, love, or desirous love.

headwords.gloss: A deep hollow in the ground; a hollow; cavity, in the ground; a pit

parts.t: A deep hollow in the ground:
cavity, in the ground; a pit:
a deep hollow, cavity, or pit;

headwords.def: هُوَّةٌ A deep hollow in the ground: (S, JK, M, Msb, K:) or a hollow, or cavity, in the ground; a pit: (Msb:) or a descent in the ground: (K:) or a deep hollow, cavity, or pit; as also : or a low, or depressed, place in the ground. (TA.) إِجْعَلِ الأَمْرَ هُوَّةً وَاحِدَةٌ Make thou the affair, or case, [ uniform, or] one uniform thing. (Fr in TA, in art. بأج .)

headwords.gloss: A vacancy; a vacuity; a vacant; an empty, space; A vacant

parts.t: A vacancy; a vacuity; a vacant,

headwords.def: هَوَآءٌ A vacancy; a vacuity; a vacant, or an empty, space. (Mgh.) A vacant, or an empty, thing. (Msb.)
هَوِىٌّ and هُوِىٌّ : see 4, (last sentence), in art. سلم .

headwords.gloss: A mortar; thing in which one pounds; bruises

parts.t: , said to be thus, with fet-h to the

headwords.def: هَاوَنٌ , said to be thus, with fet-h to the و , originally هَاوُونٌ , [ A mortar; ] the thing in which one pounds, or bruises: pl. هَوَاوِينُ . (Msb.)

headwords.gloss: An abyss; a depth; deep place, of which the bottom cannot be reached

parts.t: deep place, of which the bottom cannot be reached.

headwords.def: هَاوِيَةٌ An abyss; a depth, or deep place, of which the bottom cannot be reached. (JK, TA.)
مَهْوَى الرَّكِيَّةِ [ The cavity of the well ]. (K, voce إِزَآءٌ .) See مَهْوَاةٌ .

headwords.gloss: space between two mountains; the like; a pit
headwords.def: مَهْوَاةٌ : see هُوَّةٌ . The space between two mountains; (S, Msb;) and the like; as also : (S:) a pit, or hollow, dug, or excavated. (Msb.)
مُهَيَّأٌ i. q. زَُمَاوَرْدٌ . (MF, art. ورد .)

headword_note: Lane indexes geminate roots with two letters where the Corpus uses three; both spellings are resolved here.
